item.title: EE. UU.: los pequeños empresarios enfrentan una ola de quiebras tras los aranceles de Trump
item.description: Los pequeños negocios, responsables de generar cerca de la mitad de los empleos en Estados Unidos, enfrentan crecientes dificultades por el aumento de costos asociado a la inflación y al impacto de los aranceles. Muchos empresarios afirman que los márgenes de ganancia se han reducido y que la incertidumbre económica complica sus planes de inversión y contratación. Mientras algunos prefieren no pronunciarse públicamente por temor a posibles represalias políticas o comerciales, analistas señalan que el malestar entre los pequeños empresarios podría tener un impacto en las urnas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Record-breaking high tides spark chaos – and kayak commutes – across California
item.description: Seawater surges into low-lying communities from San Diego to San Francisco Bay Area, submerging streets, homes and businesses Historic high tides have caused chaos up and down the California coast this week, as parts of the state were inundated by record-breaking water levels. Seawater surged into low-lying communities from San Diego to the San Francisco Bay Area, submerging streets, flooding homes and businesses, and jamming important transportation corridors and train routes. Kayakers and paddle boarders could be seen gliding through typically busy thoroughfares in Marin county, north of… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: UN condemns US embargo of Cuba, but more nations sit out after Trump pressure
item.description: The UN General Assembly condemned the US economic embargo of Cuba for the 34th year on Wednesday, even as Washington’s campaign to influence the outcome led to a number of countries voting against the resolution or sitting out the decision for the first time. The vote was 130-17, with 25 abstentions – a notable decrease in support from last year, when more than 160 nations supported the measure and only 12 abstained. item.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
item.description: A high-speed train collision south of Madrid killed 68 people and injured scores more on Wednesday, with the toll likely to rise, authorities said, in one of Europe's deadliest such disasters this century. The second such accident to strike Spain this year will raise fresh questions about the country's rail safety, with the transport minister speaking of an "error" and "inexplicable circumstances" that led to the collision. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Urda, south of Madrid. Publicado también por: The New York Times - World, France 24 - English, CNBC - World, NPR - World. Fuente: BBC News - World.

El rol de Donald Trump y el de Javier Milei están en la mira por posibles colaboraciones con el senador. En tanto, la Justicia brasileña mantiene abiertas tres causas contra el excandidato presidencial que enfrentó al mandatario reelecto, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. item.title: Defeated presidential candidate Bolsonaro lands in Miami after fleeing Brazil
item.description: Brazilian Senator ​Flavio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami on Wednesday, where the United States government granted them ​entry visas after he refused to comply with a Brazilian Supreme Court order to surrender his passports. Bolsonaro lost Sunday's presidential election to leftist incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. Fuente: France 24 - English.
